id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|73c: Would you look at that... The bridge is smashed to pieces. There's no way we can cross it like this.
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|c20:
BRIDGE COLLAPSED - NO ENTRY
Turn back and look for the vines
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|181: Hey. Do you sense something weird coming from the path by that cabin? Let's take a look.
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|199: The mark on {var:1}'s hand seems to be reacting to the curiously shaped root. Hold your hand out to it?
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|1aa: The curious power has gone from this root.
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|1b2: The World Tree's root grows quietly from the ground. Nothing seems to happen.
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|1c6: Use the Fun-Size Forge there to make the gear from the recipes I gave you. Go on, try making something!
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|1d7: ...So, your first forging session's done. Nice. Did it go well?
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|1f1: Seriously? On your first try? Nice one, {var:1}! With practice, you'll get even better!
id./param/region/r003.pack|book_ie.bxon|201: Hey, I gave you all those materials! Aren't you going to try some forging? Make the gear from those recipes!
id./param/region/r003.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18b0: I'm sure the World Tree's roots will guide you down the right path.
id./param/region/r003.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1960: After all, you're one of the special ones—chosen by the World Tree. And that silky hair, too!
id./param/region/r003.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1acc: I travel all over, selling my wares. Meeting you here must be fate! Please, have a look. Now...
id./param/region/r003.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d4c: Welcome. I pay good money for well-made gear from the Fun-Size Forge. Now then...
id./param/region/r004.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb4: The Kingsbarrow's just west of here. Mind how you go, sonny!
id./param/region/r004.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb0: Eh? The Door of Departure? Dunno about grand, but there's an old shrine east of here.
id./param/region/r004.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f80: Wanting to go to a place like that? You're an odd one, sonny.
id./param/region/r004.pack|npc_ie.bxon|203c: Word is an escaped prisoner stole the King's treasure from the Kingsbarrow. It's not safe round here these days.
id./param/region/r004.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2134: Unless you've got proper business, I'd stop wandering round here and go somewhere else.
id./param/region/r004.pack|book_ie.bxon|ca8: Sorry, {var:1}, but before we head to the Door of Departure, I need to take care of my own business.
id./param/region/r004.pack|book_ie.bxon|d48: We're going to get the Red Orb they moved to the Kingsbarrow.
